status.current: covering Seven Stars and supporting Hagun representatives after their perfect first-round result

personality.summary: Energetic, sleep-deprived and media-savvy, yet sincerely grateful to Stella for avenging injured Hagun students.
fears: discouraging Stella by explaining the schedule consequences

relationships.stella-vermillion: Hugs and thanks Stella for fighting Akatsuki on behalf of Hagun, easing Stella's guilt.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Had previously investigated Amane for Ikki; explains media and schedule issues before Ikki's second-round match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Discusses the compressed schedule and Amane threat with her.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Chats with him while joining the Hagun observer group.

periods.summary: Kagami meets Ikki's group after staying up all night preparing articles about Hagun's unprecedented perfect first-round record. She explains that Stella's popularity drove global broadcast-rights bidding to an enormous level, so Stella's direct B-block advance created pressure from broadcasters and sponsors over lost match days. The committee responded by refunding part of the rights fees and compressing the schedule, causing second and third rounds to occur on one day. Kagami is careful to say Stella is not at fault, then hugs her and thanks her because Hagun students were thrilled to see Akatsuki punished for the school attack.

key_events.summary: Explains the broadcast-money reason for the accelerated schedule and reassures Stella.
